name: run-tool-entry
description: The tool-entry export of the gauntlet harness, Tools/gauntlet/harness/run.mjs (runToolEntry), and its Jet twin in the ToolCases module of the jet_gauntlet_kit package (Tools/gauntlet/kit/Source/ToolCases.jet), #5072 c8, each run by a driver that loads the fixture entries and runs the parity cases of each tool entry through Tools/agent/JetEnv.jet: an entry without a tool and one whose paths and cases are wrong (broken, with the SHA-256 of its entry.json and its directory); cases that pass, with env values added and turned to text, args turned to text, an expected nonzero exit, a fresh copy of the fixtures and a check that counts the output; cases that fail on an exit, on the first differing byte, on an absent expected file and on a check that refuses; and an entry without fixtures, whose runs start in an empty directory. Then an unknown command (exit 64).
